[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 68[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to another Hack Forum News edition. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2745296]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6332784][color=#ffffff]Chatwee Plugin[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

With Convo currently disabled following the recent server migration [mention=1] is considering installing Chatwee plugin to serve as a temporary chat solution for the community. Because Convo requires a full rebuild this third party plugin could quickly fill the void for Convo. The outdated MyBB plugin has already been updated to support PHP 8 and [mention=1] reassured members that this would strictly be a short term work around while an internal solution is finished. Would you use Chatwee in the meantime? Share your thoughts and feedback in the original thread.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6332994][color=#ffffff]Telegram Notification Bot[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

With Hack Forums web socket notification system currently offline following the server move [mention=1] is rebuilding alerts as an independent PHP plugin and planning a major overhaul to how members receive site updates. The proposed system introduces optional browser/desktop push notifications alongside a dedicated Hack Forums Telegram bot allowing you to get instant alerts for PMs, thread replies, mentions, and quotes even when you don't have the site open. Both off site options will remain completely optional with a simple linking process that requires no sensitive account credentials. What features would you like to see integrated into the new alert system? Share your thoughts and feedback in the original thread.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6332729][color=#ffffff]We're Moved[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Hack Forums has officially completed its migration over to the new server after days of preparation by [mention=1] While the site is back online members should expect temporary bugs and display errors as PHP and MyBB issues are resolved. Socket features such as Convo and notifications are currently offline and are expected to return in a few days. Members do not need to report minor bugs as logs are being actively monitored, but any critical site breaking issues should be reported directly. Be sure to check the original thread for on going updates as the migration continues.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6332952][color=#ffffff]Convo Returning[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

After spending a few hours attempting to integrate the third party chat plugin Chatwee into the forum [mention=1] confirmed that Hack Forums proprietary Convo system will officially be making its return. The brief trial with an external service underlined the unmatched value of having an in house solution that runs on Hack Forums servers, uses custom code, and allows complete flexibility for site specific features. While members will have to hang tight for a few weeks while the rebuild is carried out any doubts about Convo being permanently retired have been laid to rest. Are you glad to see Hack Forums stick with an in house chat? Share your thoughts and feedback in the original thread.

[u][b][size=large]Sony PlayStation[/size][/b][/u]

Released a base PS5 update bringing PSSR style AI upscaling and performance upgrades.

[u][b][size=large]Massive Pre Order Success[/size][/b][/u]

Anticipation for Grand Theft Auto 6 is reaching a boiling point with roughly six weeks left until its reported 19 November launch. The game has already amassed over 5 million pre orders.

[u][b][size=large]Crimson Desert DLC Delay[/size][/b][/u]

Pearl Abyss has officially pushed back its upcoming expansion to 29 October.

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/tech-brown.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Reflection AI launches an open model backed by Nvidia[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Nvidia backed Reflection AI has released its first open-weight model, Beam, aimed directly at competing with increasingly capable Chinese open models.

[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/technology/nvidia-backed-reflection-unveils-first-ai-model-take-chinese-open-models-2026-10-05]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Nvidia is working on rogue AI protection[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Nvidia has launched an Open Agent Safety Platform designed to help monitor AI agents and contain potentially dangerous behaviour using sandboxed environments.

[b][url=https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/artificial-intelligence/this-week-on-toms-hardware-premium-october-3-2026-ai-chip-design-week-openai-interview-and-ai-agent-safety]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Apple wants to restrict AI agents on Macs[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Apple's new approach to macOS permissions is getting interesting this week. AI agents increasingly need deep system access to accomplish tasks, but giving an AI unrestricted access to your filesystem is obviously dangerous. Apple is therefore changing how Full Disk Access works to make it harder for automated agents to obtain broad access.

[b][url=https://www.theverge.com/tech/1004295/apple-limit-mac-disk-access-ai-agents]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Amazon refreshes the Kindle, again...[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Amazon has introduced refreshed Kindles with a new range of colours, a page changing button and a aluminium construction instead of plastic. Amazon have claimed it's part of a broader push to make dedicated e-readers feel more like premium hardware rather than inexpensive screens.

[b][url=https://www.techradar.com/tech/icymi-the-8-biggest-tech-stories-of-the-week-from-metas-ai-agent-to-a-big-refresh-for-the-amazon-kindle]Source[/url][/b]
